usage: Every component is a function on window.JointBobKit that takes one options object and returns an element. Layout children may be elements or { "component": name, "props": {...}, "span": 2 | "full" }. Read the data with JointBobKit.payload() and draw with JointBobKit.mount(...). Formats: number (compact, the default), integer, percent (a fraction: 0.12 is 12%), usd, raw.

components.name: grid
components.summary: Responsive grid of cards; columns optional (1–4). Children wrap on narrow screens.

components.name: section
components.summary: A titled group of components with an optional one-line description.

props.body: Bugs per day after the last fix.

components.name: kpi
components.summary: One headline number with an optional signed change against a named period and a small trend line. goodDirection says whether up is good.

components.name: timeSeries
components.summary: Change over time: one line per series (at most 8), optional area wash, and markers for events such as a deployed fix. Points are { t: ISO date, v: number }.

components.name: bar
components.summary: Magnitude per category as columns; horizontal: true for rankings and long labels.

components.name: stackedBar
components.summary: Parts of a whole per category; series values line up with categories (at most 8 series).

components.name: donut
components.summary: Share of a whole for a few parts (at most 8); the total is in the middle.

components.name: heatmap
components.summary: Magnitude over two dimensions such as day × type or day × hour; values[row][column].

components.name: table
components.summary: Rows with sortable columns, paged (pageSize, default 10) instead of scrolling. A column may set align: "right" and a format.

components.name: badges
components.summary: States with an icon and a label: good, warning, serious, critical or info, with optional detail.

components.name: text
components.summary: Plain paragraphs, split on blank lines. No markup.

example.title: Notes
example.body:
Counts are deduplicated by correlation id.

A day starts at midnight UTC.

components.name: lastRefreshed
components.summary: When the shown data was produced, from the payload's generatedAt.

components.name: state
components.summary: An empty, loading or error state with an optional message.
